gene_chromosome_annotation.method: Approved HGNC ID exact match; chromosome inferred from cytogenetic location; ambiguous locations unmapped
gene_chromosome_annotation.source: HGNC complete approved set (external annotation overlay)

methodology.anatomy: Category memberships overlap; category or chromosome stacks are not globally additive. Gene chromosomes are exact HGNC ID matches from a dated annotation overlay.
methodology.rankings: Distinct canonical entities. Each shared-trial disease-drug pair assigned to its highest reported trial phase; phase stacks sum to globally distinct pairs.
methodology.target_overlap: Target-only connections are discovery hypotheses, not direct therapeutic evidence.
methodology.trial: A disease and drug sharing a clinical trial is co-occurrence evidence, not proof of treatment.
